stories.title: Jobs plans set out new youth apprenticeships and placements
stories.summary: BIST and DWP announced employer commitments to 22,400 new under-25 professional/business-services apprenticeships annually over five years, alongside 40,000 annual construction placements within a previously announced ambition. These are planned opportunities, not jobs already delivered; the linked PBS plan is covered here once.

stories.title: Published drought direction prioritises essential water supplies
stories.summary: A newly published legal direction prioritises public supply around Wimbleball, Ardingly, Roadford and Colliford reservoirs, with monitored, proportionate temporary measures. It took effect on 15 October: this is publication of the instrument, not a new drought declaration or suspension of environmental duties.

stories.title: Environment Agency publishes UKEAP air-pollution technical reporting
stories.summary: Newly published technical reporting describes monitoring-network activities and data; the 2025 report was prepared by UKCEH and WSP UK for the Environment Agency and Defra. This is reporting on an earlier year, not a new supplier award.

stories.title: Farmer family’s civil case against MoD opens in Belfast
stories.summary: BBC reports allegations in the Sean Farmer family’s civil case concerning his 1975 killing. The family’s barrister alleged security-force involvement; these are court submissions, not findings that the MoD was liable.

stories.title: Outgoing Red Arrows leader discusses team’s future
stories.summary: Former team leader Jon Bond told BBC there would always be a place for the Red Arrows as the ageing Hawk fleet approaches retirement. The newly published interview follows his Friday departure; it does not establish a new aircraft contract or supplier.

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

stories.title: Science advisers publish AI-sovereignty recommendations
stories.summary: The Council for Science and Technology published a letter recommending an AI-sovereignty plan, coordinated governance, domestic capability and trusted model access. The letter is dated 30 July and addressed to the Cabinet Office’s AI minister: newly published advice, not adopted BIST policy, approved pilots or funding.

stories.title: BIST opens selection process for independent ballot scrutineers
stories.summary: Organisations can apply by 17 January 2027 to join an updated statutory list for trade-union and CAC ballots, including electronic/hybrid voting. This is an open qualification process, not an awarded contract or a named supplier selection.
